8. 1.6 Socio-Economic Considerations
Similar to the Bad Creek site, the Long Spur Ridge alternative would be located in a rugged, remote area away from population centers or business developments; therefore no persons would have to be relocated should a project be constructed here. Since the reservoir would be located in Transylvania County, North Carolina, and the powerhouse in Oconee County, South Carolina, a portion of the tax revenues generated by the project would go to Transylvania County.
